panels.title: Income — last complete month (€)
panels.description: Ordinary income for the most recent COMPLETE calendar month (the current month is excluded because it is still in progress). The resolved month is shown next to the value. Requires the finance trust gate to pass; blank means the gate failed, not zero income.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH lm AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now')) SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM ordinary_income i WHERE i.month=lm.month)/100.0 END AS "Income €",lm.month AS "Month" FROM lm CROSS JOIN finance_trust f

panels.title: Consumption — last complete month (€)
panels.description: Absolute canonical consumption for the most recent COMPLETE calendar month; the in-progress current month is excluded so this is comparable with the income tile beside it. Requires the finance trust gate to pass.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH lm AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now')) SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 THEN (SELECT ABS(COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0)) FROM consumption c WHERE c.month=lm.month)/100.0 END AS "Consumption €",lm.month AS "Month" FROM lm CROSS JOIN finance_trust f

panels.title: Savings rate — last complete month (%)
panels.description: TRUE savings rate: (ordinary income − consumption) / ordinary income, for the most recent COMPLETE month. Negative (red) means more was consumed than earned that month. This is deliberately NOT the investment-contribution ratio the tile used to show — that read 0% in months where money was actually being lost.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH lm AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now')),m AS (SELECT lm.month month,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM ordinary_income i WHERE i.month=lm.month) inc,(SELECT ABS(COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0)) FROM consumption c WHERE c.month=lm.month) cons FROM lm) SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 AND m.inc>0 THEN ROUND(100.0*(m.inc-m.cons)/m.inc,1) END AS "Savings rate",m.month AS "Month" FROM m CROSS JOIN finance_trust f

panels.title: Investment contributions — last complete month (€)
panels.description: Transfers from on-budget accounts into off-budget savings/investment accounts in the most recent COMPLETE month. Decoupled from budget_snapshots (which holds only a single month and used to make this tile render blank); COALESCE guarantees a month with no contributions shows 0,00 rather than nothing.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH lm AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now')) SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM savings_contributions s WHERE s.month=lm.month),0)/100.0 END AS "Contributions €",lm.month AS "Month" FROM lm CROSS JOIN finance_trust f

panels.title: Monthly income, consumption, and contributions (€)
panels.description: € per month over the trailing 24 months. The current in-progress month is excluded so the last point is never an artificial dip. Contributions are built on a month spine, so months with no ETF purchase plot 0,00 instead of breaking the line.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',month||'-01') AS INTEGER) AS time,SUM(amount_cents)/100.0 AS "Ordinary income" FROM ordinary_income WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND date>=date('now','-24 months','start of month') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',month||'-01') AS INTEGER) AS time,ABS(SUM(amount_cents))/100.0 AS Consumption FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND date>=date('now','-24 months','start of month') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH spine AS (SELECT DISTINCT month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND date>=date('now','-24 months','start of month')) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',s.month||'-01') AS INTEGER) AS time,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM savings_contributions v WHERE v.month=s.month),0)/100.0 AS Contributions FROM spine s ORDER BY s.month

panels.title: Consumption mix by canonical role (€)
panels.description: € per month by canonical role over the trailing 12 complete months. Only the roles that actually occur in the consumption view are plotted: fixed, essential, discretionary. The former 'Sinking funds' series was removed — no transaction has ever carried category_role='sinking_fund', so it was a permanently-zero band. Note that the consumption view contains no NULL-role rows either, so there is nothing uncategorised to surface here.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT month AS Month,ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN category_role='fixed' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END))/100.0 AS Fixed,ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN category_role='essential' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END))/100.0 AS Essential,ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN category_role='discretionary' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END))/100.0 AS Discretionary FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND date>=date('now','-12 months','start of month') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

panels.title: Month-over-month category drivers (€)
panels.description: The two most recent COMPLETE months compared side by side, ranked by absolute change. The compared months are derived from the consumption view itself and are printed in the 'Latest month' and 'Prior month' columns. Previously both months were taken from budget_snapshots, which holds a single month — so Latest and Prior collapsed onto the same month and every Change read 0,00. Categories that appeared or disappeared are included with 0,00 on the missing side.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH months AS (SELECT DISTINCT month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 2),latest AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM months),prev AS (SELECT MIN(month) month FROM months),cur AS (SELECT COALESCE(category_name,'(uncategorised)') label,ABS(SUM(amount_cents)) cents FROM consumption WHERE month=(SELECT month FROM latest) GROUP BY 1),prior_values AS (SELECT COALESCE(category_name,'(uncategorised)') label,ABS(SUM(amount_cents)) cents FROM consumption WHERE month=(SELECT month FROM prev) GROUP BY 1),driver_keys AS (SELECT label FROM cur UNION SELECT label FROM prior_values) SELECT k.label AS Category,latest.month AS "Latest month",ROUND(COALESCE(cur.cents,0)/100.0,2) AS "Latest €",prev.month AS "Prior month",ROUND(COALESCE(prior_values.cents,0)/100.0,2) AS "Prior €",ROUND((COALESCE(cur.cents,0)-COALESCE(prior_values.cents,0))/100.0,2) AS "Change €" FROM driver_keys k LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.label=k.label LEFT JOIN prior_values ON prior_values.label=k.label CROSS JOIN latest CROSS JOIN prev ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(cur.cents,0)-COALESCE(prior_values.cents,0)) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Month-over-month merchant drivers (€)
panels.description: The two most recent COMPLETE months compared per merchant, ranked by absolute change; the compared months are printed in 'Latest month' and 'Prior month'. Same fix as the category table — the month pair now comes from the consumption view instead of the single-month budget_snapshots table, so Latest and Prior are genuinely different months. Merchants that appeared or disappeared are included with 0,00 on the missing side.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH months AS (SELECT DISTINCT month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 2),latest AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM months),prev AS (SELECT MIN(month) month FROM months),cur AS (SELECT COALESCE(payee_name,'(no payee)') label,ABS(SUM(amount_cents)) cents FROM consumption WHERE month=(SELECT month FROM latest) GROUP BY 1),prior_values AS (SELECT COALESCE(payee_name,'(no payee)') label,ABS(SUM(amount_cents)) cents FROM consumption WHERE month=(SELECT month FROM prev) GROUP BY 1),driver_keys AS (SELECT label FROM cur UNION SELECT label FROM prior_values) SELECT k.label AS Merchant,latest.month AS "Latest month",ROUND(COALESCE(cur.cents,0)/100.0,2) AS "Latest €",prev.month AS "Prior month",ROUND(COALESCE(prior_values.cents,0)/100.0,2) AS "Prior €",ROUND((COALESCE(cur.cents,0)-COALESCE(prior_values.cents,0))/100.0,2) AS "Change €" FROM driver_keys k LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.label=k.label LEFT JOIN prior_values ON prior_values.label=k.label CROSS JOIN latest CROSS JOIN prev ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(cur.cents,0)-COALESCE(prior_values.cents,0)) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Consumption and three-month rolling average (€)
panels.description: € per month over the trailing 24 complete months, against a trailing three-month average. The in-progress current month is excluded so it cannot drag the average down.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH monthly AS (SELECT month,ABS(SUM(amount_cents))/100.0 value FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND date>=date('now','-24 months','start of month') GROUP BY month) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',month||'-01') AS INTEGER) AS time,value AS "Consumption €",ROUND(AVG(value) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),2) AS "3-month average €" FROM monthly ORDER BY month

panels.title: Spending by category — last complete month (€)
panels.description: Where the money actually went in the most recent COMPLETE month, top 15 categories by absolute spend. Replaces the old 'Annualized irregular-cost funding' panel, which filtered category_role='sinking_fund' — a role no transaction has ever carried, so that panel could only ever render 'No Data'.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH lm AS (SELECT MAX(month) month FROM consumption WHERE month<strftime('%Y-%m','now')) SELECT c.category_name AS Category,ROUND(ABS(SUM(c.amount_cents))/100.0,2) AS "Spend €" FROM consumption c JOIN lm ON lm.month=c.month GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY ABS(SUM(c.amount_cents)) DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Recent unusual consumption (€)
panels.description: Charges in the last 30 days that reached at least twice their merchant's 180-day average, for merchants with at least three observations. Renders an explicit 'None — ...' row instead of 'No Data' when nothing is anomalous.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH payee_baseline AS (SELECT payee_name,AVG(ABS(amount_cents)) avg_cents,COUNT(*) observations FROM consumption WHERE date>=date('now','-180 days') AND payee_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payee_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=3),hits AS (SELECT c.date AS "Date",c.payee_name AS Merchant,c.category_name AS Category,ROUND(ABS(c.amount_cents)/100.0,2) AS "Amount €",ROUND(p.avg_cents/100.0,2) AS "180-day average €",ROUND(ABS(c.amount_cents)/p.avg_cents,1) AS Multiple,p.observations AS "Baseline observations" FROM consumption c JOIN payee_baseline p ON p.payee_name=c.payee_name WHERE c.date>=date('now','-30 days') AND ABS(c.amount_cents)>=2*p.avg_cents ORDER BY ABS(c.amount_cents)/p.avg_cents DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT * FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT '—','None — no charge in the last 30 days reached 2x its 180-day merchant baseline',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits) ORDER BY Multiple DESC

panels.title: Recurring spend per month — creep detector (€)
panels.description: € per month over the trailing 18 complete months for the Bills, Bills (Flexible), Subscriptions, Donations & Memberships and Gym & Fitness categories, broken out per category. Slow-rising lines indicate subscription creep. The in-progress current month is excluded so a part-billed month is not misread as a saving.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',month||'-01') AS INTEGER) AS time,category_name AS metric,ABS(SUM(amount_cents))/100.0 AS value FROM consumption WHERE category_name IN ('Bills','Bills (Flexible)','Subscriptions','Donations & Memberships','Gym & Fitness') AND month<strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND date>=date('now','-18 months') GROUP BY month,category_name ORDER BY month

panels.title: Stale subscriptions — was recurring, recently silent (€)
panels.description: Cadence-detected subscriptions the detector has marked inactive — was recurring, has gone silent. Cancellation-candidate surface, ordered by days since the last charge. Renders an explicit 'None — ...' row instead of 'No Data' when every detected subscription is still charging.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH stale AS (SELECT payee_name AS Payee,cadence AS Cadence,ROUND(median_cents/100.0,2) AS "Was: median €",ROUND(annualized_cents/100.0,2) AS "Was: per year €",count AS Count,first_seen AS "First seen",last_seen AS "Last seen",days_since_last AS "Days since" FROM subscriptions WHERE is_active=0) SELECT * FROM stale UNION ALL SELECT 'None — every detected subscription is still charging on cadence',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stale) ORDER BY "Days since" ASC

panels.title: New recurring this month — payees first seen since the 1st (€)
panels.description: Consumption-role payees with spend since the start of this month that had no prior consumption-role spend. Anomaly surface: did you intentionally sign up for these? This panel deliberately covers the CURRENT, in-progress month. Renders an explicit 'None — ...' row instead of 'No Data' when there are no new payees.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH fresh AS (SELECT payee_name AS Payee,COUNT(*) AS Txns,ROUND(ABS(SUM(amount_cents))/100.0,2) AS "Spend so far €",MIN(date) AS "First seen",MAX(date) AS "Last seen" FROM consumption WHERE date>=date('now','start of month') AND payee_name IS NOT NULL AND payee_name NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT payee_name FROM consumption WHERE payee_name IS NOT NULL AND date<date('now','start of month')) GROUP BY payee_name) SELECT * FROM fresh UNION ALL SELECT 'None — every payee seen this month has prior on-budget history',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh) ORDER BY "Spend so far €" DESC
